name: 02-index-laws-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="Chart of the index laws: multiplication adds indices, division subtracts indices, a power of a power multiplies indices, zero index gives one and a negative index gives a reciprocal" viewBox="0 0 760 320" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">The index laws</text>

<rect x="40" y="58" width="330" height="66" rx="10" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/><text x="205" y="98" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e3a8a">aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ</text>
<rect x="390" y="58" width="330" height="66" rx="10" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/><text x="555" y="98" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e3a8a">aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = aᵐ⁻ⁿ</text>
<rect x="40" y="140" width="330" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="205" y="180" text-anchor="middle" fill="#134e4a">(aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ</text>
<rect x="390" y="140" width="330" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="555" y="180" text-anchor="middle" fill="#134e4a">a⁰ = 1  (a ≠ 0)</text>
<rect x="40" y="222" width="330" height="66" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/><text x="205" y="262" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e">a⁻ⁿ = 1 / aⁿ</text>
<rect x="390" y="222" width="330" height="66" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/><text x="555" y="262" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e">aᵐᐟⁿ = ⁿ√(aᵐ)</text>
</g></svg>

name: 02-index-laws-p05-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="Diagram showing how a fractional index splits into a root and a power, with eight to the power two thirds equal to the cube root of eight squared, giving four" viewBox="0 0 760 260" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Reading a fractional index</text>
<text x="380" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="34" fill="#1e3a8a">8²ᐟ³</text>
<line x1="300" y1="112" x2="200" y2="152" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="460" y1="112" x2="560" y2="152" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="180" y="180" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" fill="#0f766e">denominator 3</text><text x="180" y="206" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" fill="#0f766e">→ cube ROOT</text>
<text x="580" y="180" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" fill="#b45309">numerator 2</text><text x="580" y="206" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" fill="#b45309">→ POWER 2</text>
<text x="380" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-size="24" fill="#334155">(∛8)² = 2² = 4</text>
<text x="380" y="238" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#64748b">Take the root first — the numbers stay small</text></svg>

name: 03-surds-and-rationalising-denominators-p17-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="Diagram of rationalising a denominator by multiplying numerator and denominator by the conjugate, turning root five minus two into a rational denominator" viewBox="0 0 760 260" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Rationalising with a conjugate</text>
<rect x="40" y="62" width="200" height="76" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/><text x="140" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" fill="#7f1d1d">3 / (√5 − 2)</text>
<text x="300" y="108" font-size="26" fill="#475569">×</text>
<rect x="336" y="62" width="230" height="76" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="451" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="#134e4a">(√5 + 2)</text><text x="451" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="#134e4a">(√5 + 2)</text>
<text x="600" y="108" font-size="26" fill="#475569">=</text>
<rect x="626" y="62" width="106" height="76" rx="10" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/><text x="679" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="#1e3a8a">3(√5+2)</text>
<text x="380" y="184" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="#334155">Denominator: (√5 − 2)(√5 + 2) = 5 − 4 = 1</text>

name: 04-expanding-brackets-p06-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="Chart of the three key expansion identities: square of a sum, square of a difference and difference of two squares" viewBox="0 0 760 250" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Three identities worth memorising</text>
<g font-size="21">
<rect x="40" y="58" width="680" height="52" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="380" y="92" text-anchor="middle" fill="#134e4a">(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²</text>
<rect x="40" y="124" width="680" height="52" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="380" y="158" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e3a8a">(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²</text>

</g></svg>

name: 05-factorising-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="Flow chart for choosing a factorising method: common factor first, then difference of two squares, then quadratic with unit coefficient, then quadratic with a leading coefficient, then grouping" viewBox="0 0 760 330" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Which method?</text>
<defs><marker id="fr-arrow" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="5" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill="#64748b"/></marker></defs>
<g font-size="18">
<rect x="150" y="52" width="460" height="48" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="380" y="82" text-anchor="middle" fill="#134e4a">1. Common factor in every term? Take it out first</text>
<rect x="150" y="118" width="460" height="48" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="380" y="148" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e3a8a">2. Two terms, both squares, subtracted? a² − b²</text>
<rect x="150" y="184" width="460" height="48" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="380" y="214" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e3a8a">3. x² + bx + c? Find two numbers: sum b, product c</text>
<rect x="150" y="250" width="460" height="48" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/><text x="380" y="280" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e">4. ax² + bx + c? Split the middle term using ac</text>

<text x="380" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Solving a quadratic</text>
<defs><marker id="qr-a" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="5" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill="#64748b"/></marker></defs>

<text x="380" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" fill="#1e3a8a">x² + 6x + 2 = (x + 3)² − 9 + 2 = (x + 3)² − 7</text>

<text x="380" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#64748b">The bracket sign flips: (x + p)² has its minimum at x = −p</text></svg>

name: 54-introduction-to-integration-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A diagram showing differentiation and integration as reverse processes, with the power rule for integration stated and a family of parallel curves differing by the constant of integration" viewBox="0 0 760 380" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Integration reverses differentiation</text>
<rect x="60" y="60" width="180" height="66" rx="12" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="150" y="102" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" fill="#1d4ed8">x³</text>
<rect x="360" y="60" width="180" height="66" rx="12" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="450" y="102" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" fill="#0f766e">3x²</text>
<path d="M245 80 L355 80" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.6" marker-end="url(#a1)"/>
<path d="M355 110 L245 110" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.6" marker-end="url(#a2)"/>
<defs>
<marker id="a1" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="7" refY="4.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0 L9 4.5 L0 9 z" fill="#1d4ed8"/></marker>
<marker id="a2" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="7" refY="4.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0 L9 4.5 L0 9 z" fill="#0f766e"/></marker></defs>
<text x="300" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#1d4ed8">differentiate</text>
<text x="300" y="130" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#0f766e">integrate</text>
<text x="380" y="176" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#4338ca">∫ xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹ / (n + 1) + c</text>
<text x="380" y="204" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">raise the index by one, divide by the new index</text>
<line x1="90" y1="350" x2="330" y2="350" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.6"/>
<path d="M110 340 Q210 240 310 300" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.4"/>

<path d="M110 288 Q210 188 310 248" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.4" opacity="0.35"/>

<g font-size="17" fill="#b45309">

<text x="400" y="290">family of curves — all with</text>

name: 55-integrating-polynomials-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A worked layout showing a polynomial integrated term by term, with each term's index raised and divided, and a table of the standard cases including constants, negative indices and roots" viewBox="0 0 760 360" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Integrate a polynomial term by term</text>
<g font-size="20" fill="#1d4ed8">
<text x="60" y="80">∫ ( 6x²</text><text x="200" y="80">−  4x</text><text x="320" y="80">+  5 ) dx</text></g>
<g stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="5 4">
<line x1="95" y1="92" x2="95" y2="126"/><line x1="235" y1="92" x2="235" y2="126"/><line x1="365" y1="92" x2="365" y2="126"/></g>
<g font-size="20" fill="#0f766e">
<text x="60" y="152">2x³</text><text x="200" y="152">−  2x²</text><text x="320" y="152">+  5x</text><text x="440" y="152">+  c</text></g>
<line x1="55" y1="176" x2="705" y2="176" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.6"/>
<g font-size="18" fill="#334155">
<text x="70" y="212">∫ k dx</text><text x="300" y="212">=  kx + c</text>
<text x="70" y="248">∫ x dx</text><text x="300" y="248">=  ½x² + c</text>

<text x="380" y="350" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#b45309">the rule fails only for n = −1, since dividing by zero is impossible</text></svg>

<circle cx="400" cy="90" r="6" fill="#b45309"/>

<text x="396" y="118" font-size="16" fill="#b45309">x = b</text>
<text x="250" y="120" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#1e3a8a">enclosed region</text>
<text x="330" y="196" font-size="15" fill="#0f766e">lower graph</text>

name: 59-differential-equations-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A diagram showing how a differential equation for a rate of change is separated and integrated to give a general solution, then fitted to an initial condition to give a particular solution" viewBox="0 0 760 350" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">From a rate of change to the function itself</text>
<rect x="50" y="58" width="200" height="62" rx="12" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="150" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#1d4ed8">dy/dx = f(x)</text>
<text x="150" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#64748b">the rate is known</text>
<rect x="280" y="58" width="200" height="62" rx="12" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#0f766e">y = ∫ f(x) dx</text>
<text x="380" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#64748b">general solution, + c</text>
<rect x="510" y="58" width="200" height="62" rx="12" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#b45309">c found from a point</text>
<text x="610" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#64748b">particular solution</text>
<path d="M255 88 L275 88" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2.4"/>
<path d="M485 88 L505 88" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2.4"/>
<line x1="60" y1="150" x2="700" y2="150" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.6"/>
<g font-size="18" fill="#334155">
<text x="70" y="186">rate of change of volume</text><text x="420" y="186">dV/dt</text>
<text x="70" y="222">rate of change of temperature</text><text x="420" y="222">dθ/dt</text>
<text x="70" y="258">rate of change of population</text><text x="420" y="258">dP/dt</text></g>
<text x="380" y="304" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#4338ca">"per second", "per hour" → the variable in the denominator</text>
<text x="380" y="334" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#0f766e">integrate with respect to that variable to recover the quantity</text></svg>

name: 60-displacement-velocity-acceleration-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A chain showing displacement, velocity and acceleration linked by differentiation in one direction and integration in the other, with the units of each quantity listed" viewBox="0 0 760 350" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Differentiate down the chain, integrate back up</text>
<rect x="70" y="70" width="170" height="72" rx="12" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="155" y="102" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" fill="#1d4ed8">displacement s</text>
<text x="155" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">metres (m)</text>
<rect x="295" y="70" width="170" height="72" rx="12" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380" y="102" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" fill="#0f766e">velocity v</text>
<text x="380" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">m s⁻¹</text>
<rect x="520" y="70" width="170" height="72" rx="12" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605" y="102" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" fill="#b45309">acceleration a</text>
<text x="605" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">m s⁻²</text>
<path d="M245 92 L290 92" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.6"/>
<path d="M470 92 L515 92" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.6"/>
<text x="267" y="82" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#1d4ed8">d/dt</text>
<text x="492" y="82" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#1d4ed8">d/dt</text>
<path d="M290 124 L245 124" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.6"/>
<path d="M515 124 L470 124" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.6"/>
<text x="267" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#0f766e">∫dt</text>
<text x="492" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#0f766e">∫dt</text>
<line x1="70" y1="176" x2="690" y2="176" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.6"/>
<g font-size="18" fill="#334155">
<text x="90" y="210">v = ds/dt</text><text x="330" y="210">a = dv/dt = d²s/dt²</text>
<text x="90" y="248">s = ∫ v dt</text><text x="330" y="248">v = ∫ a dt</text></g>
<g font-size="17" fill="#4338ca">
<text x="90" y="290">at rest → v = 0</text>
<text x="330" y="290">maximum velocity → a = 0</text>
<text x="90" y="322">back at start → s = 0</text>
<text x="330" y="322" fill="#b45309">negative v means moving backwards</text></g></svg>

name: 61-constant-acceleration-equations-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A velocity time graph for constant acceleration showing a straight line from initial velocity u to final velocity v over time t, with the trapezium area representing displacement, and the four constant acceleration equations listed" viewBox="0 0 760 350" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Constant acceleration: a straight velocity–time graph</text>
<line x1="80" y1="270" x2="380" y2="270" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="80" y1="60" x2="80" y2="270" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<polygon points="80,220 320,110 320,270 80,270" fill="#bfdbfe" opacity="0.75"/>
<line x1="80" y1="220" x2="320" y2="110" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="62" y="226" text-anchor="end" font-size="17" fill="#1d4ed8">u</text>
<text x="336" y="112" font-size="17" fill="#1d4ed8">v</text>
<text x="320" y="292" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#475569">t</text>
<text x="200" y="200" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#1e3a8a">area = displacement s</text>
<text x="240" y="330" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">gradient = acceleration a</text>
<g font-size="20" fill="#4338ca">
<text x="430" y="90">v = u + at</text>
<text x="430" y="134">s = ut + ½at²</text>

<g font-size="16" fill="#64748b">
<text x="430" y="266">five quantities: s, u, v, a, t</text>
<text x="430" y="292">list what is known, choose the</text>
<text x="430" y="318">equation missing the unwanted one</text></g></svg>

name: 65-variable-acceleration-p03-1.png
svg:

<text x="552" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" fill="#1d4ed8">a depends on t</text>
<g font-size="17" fill="#334155">
<text x="76" y="128">v = u + at</text>
<text x="76" y="160">s = ut + ½at²</text>
<text x="76" y="192">v² = u² + 2as</text>
<text x="76" y="224">s = ½(u + v)t</text>
<text x="418" y="128">v = ds/dt</text>

<text x="380" y="328" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#b45309">if a contains t, the standard equations do not apply</text></svg>

<text x="140" y="196" font-size="15" fill="#4338ca">resultant R</text>
<g font-size="19" fill="#4338ca">
<text x="380" y="100">R = ΣF</text>
<text x="380" y="142">|R| = √(X² + Y²)</text>
<text x="380" y="184">θ = tan⁻¹(Y / X)</text></g>
<g font-size="16" fill="#64748b">
<text x="380" y="228">X = sum of all i components</text>
<text x="380" y="254">Y = sum of all j components</text></g>
<text x="380" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#0f766e">equilibrium: R = 0, so X = 0 and Y = 0</text>
<text x="380" y="330" font-size="16" fill="#b45309">force is measured in newtons (N)</text></svg>

name: 69-newtons-first-law-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A diagram of a block resting on a table showing weight downwards balanced by the normal reaction upwards, and an applied force balanced by friction, illustrating that balanced forces give no acceleration" viewBox="0 0 760 350" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Balanced forces: at rest or at constant velocity</text>
<line x1="70" y1="230" x2="400" y2="230" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="180" y="180" width="110" height="50" rx="6" fill="#e2e8f0" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="235" y="211" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#334155">block</text>
<line x1="235" y1="180" x2="235" y2="100" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="3.4"/>
<path d="M229 108 L235 96 L241 108" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="246" y="126" font-size="16" fill="#0f766e">R (normal reaction)</text>
<line x1="235" y1="230" x2="235" y2="310" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="3.4"/>
<path d="M229 302 L235 314 L241 302" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="246" y="300" font-size="16" fill="#b45309">W = mg (weight)</text>
<line x1="290" y1="205" x2="368" y2="205" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3.4"/>
<path d="M360 199 L372 205 L360 211" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
<text x="300" y="192" font-size="15" fill="#1d4ed8">applied force P</text>
<line x1="180" y1="205" x2="104" y2="205" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="3.4"/>
<path d="M112 199 L100 205 L112 211" fill="#4338ca"/>
<text x="96" y="192" font-size="15" fill="#4338ca">friction F</text>
<g font-size="18" fill="#334155">
<text x="440" y="100">vertically: R = mg</text>
<text x="440" y="136">horizontally: P = F</text></g>
<g font-size="16" fill="#64748b">
<text x="440" y="184">no resultant force means</text>
<text x="440" y="210">no acceleration —</text>
<text x="440" y="236">the body stays at rest or</text>
<text x="440" y="262">keeps a constant velocity</text></g>
<text x="440" y="310" font-size="17" fill="#0f766e">weight: W = mg, with g = 9.8 m s⁻²</text></svg>

name: 70-newtons-second-law-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A diagram showing a block with a forward driving force larger than the backward resistance, the resultant force producing an acceleration in the direction of motion, with the equation resultant force equals mass times acceleration" viewBox="0 0 760 350" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Unbalanced forces produce acceleration</text>
<rect x="150" y="120" width="130" height="66" rx="8" fill="#e2e8f0" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="215" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#334155">mass m</text>
<line x1="280" y1="153" x2="410" y2="153" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="4"/>
<path d="M400 146 L414 153 L400 160" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
<text x="330" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#1d4ed8">driving force P</text>
<line x1="150" y1="153" x2="70" y2="153" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="4"/>
<path d="M80 146 L66 153 L80 160" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="106" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#b45309">resistance F</text>
<line x1="150" y1="228" x2="300" y2="228" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="4"/>
<path d="M290 221 L304 228 L290 235" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="225" y="254" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#0f766e">acceleration a</text>
<text x="215" y="292" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#64748b">a is in the direction of the resultant</text>
<g font-size="21" fill="#4338ca">
<text x="450" y="110">R = ma</text>
<text x="450" y="152">P − F = ma</text></g>
<g font-size="16" fill="#64748b">
<text x="450" y="200">take the positive direction as</text>
<text x="450" y="226">the direction of motion</text>
<text x="450" y="266">1 N accelerates 1 kg at 1 m s⁻²</text>
<text x="450" y="308" fill="#b45309">negative a means deceleration</text></g></svg>

name: 71-weight-and-normal-reaction-p04-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A diagram of a person in a lift showing the normal reaction from the floor compared with the weight for a lift accelerating upwards, moving at constant velocity, and accelerating downwards" viewBox="0 0 760 360" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">The normal reaction is not always equal to the weight</text>
<g stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
<rect x="70" y="70" width="180" height="200" rx="8"/>
<rect x="290" y="70" width="180" height="200" rx="8"/>
<rect x="510" y="70" width="180" height="200" rx="8"/></g>
<text x="160" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#0f766e">accelerating up</text>
<text x="380" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#1d4ed8">constant velocity</text>
<text x="600" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#b45309">accelerating down</text>
<g font-size="18" fill="#334155">
<text x="160" y="150" text-anchor="middle">R − mg = ma</text>
<text x="380" y="150" text-anchor="middle">R − mg = 0</text>
<text x="600" y="150" text-anchor="middle">mg − R = ma</text></g>
<g font-size="20" fill="#4338ca">
<text x="160" y="196" text-anchor="middle">R > mg</text>
<text x="380" y="196" text-anchor="middle">R = mg</text>
<text x="600" y="196" text-anchor="middle">R < mg</text></g>
<g font-size="15" fill="#64748b">
<text x="160" y="238" text-anchor="middle">feels heavier</text>
<text x="380" y="238" text-anchor="middle">feels normal</text>
<text x="600" y="238" text-anchor="middle">feels lighter</text></g>
<text x="380" y="308" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#0f766e">always resolve in the direction of the acceleration</text>
<text x="380" y="338" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#b45309">in free fall R = 0 — apparent weightlessness</text></svg>

name: 72-friction-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A graph showing the frictional force rising in step with an increasing applied force until it reaches its limiting value, after which it stays constant while the body slides" viewBox="0 0 760 360" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Friction rises to a limit, then stays there</text>
<line x1="90" y1="290" x2="470" y2="290" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="90" y1="290" x2="90" y2="70" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="280" y="322" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#475569">applied force P</text>
<text x="52" y="180" font-size="16" fill="#475569" transform="rotate(-90 52 180)">friction F</text>
<line x1="90" y1="290" x2="250" y2="150" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3.4"/>
<line x1="250" y1="150" x2="450" y2="150" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="3.4"/>
<line x1="90" y1="150" x2="250" y2="150" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
<line x1="250" y1="150" x2="250" y2="290" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
<circle cx="250" cy="150" r="5" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="84" y="142" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" fill="#b45309">μR</text>
<text x="250" y="312" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#b45309">limiting point</text>
<text x="150" y="206" font-size="15" fill="#1d4ed8">F = P (static)</text>
<text x="352" y="136" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#0f766e">F = μR (sliding)</text>
<g font-size="19" fill="#4338ca">
<text x="500" y="110">F ≤ μR</text>
<text x="500" y="152">F = μR at the limit</text></g>
<g font-size="16" fill="#64748b">
<text x="500" y="200">μ is the coefficient</text>
<text x="500" y="226">of friction — no units</text>
<text x="500" y="266" fill="#b45309">smooth surface: μ = 0</text>
<text x="500" y="300" fill="#0f766e">friction opposes the motion</text>
<text x="500" y="326" fill="#0f766e">or the tendency to move</text></g></svg>

name: 73-connected-particles-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A diagram of two blocks connected by a string over a pulley, showing the tension acting on each block and the whole system treated as one body, with separate equations for each particle" viewBox="0 0 760 360" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Two particles, one string, one acceleration</text>
<line x1="60" y1="110" x2="300" y2="110" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="3"/>
<circle cx="300" cy="110" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="110" y="118" width="96" height="48" rx="6" fill="#e2e8f0" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="158" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#334155">A, mass M</text>
<line x1="206" y1="142" x2="290" y2="126" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="238" y="180" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#1d4ed8">T</text>
<line x1="316" y1="110" x2="316" y2="200" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="272" y="200" width="90" height="48" rx="6" fill="#e2e8f0" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="317" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#334155">B, mass m</text>
<line x1="317" y1="248" x2="317" y2="315" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="3"/>
<path d="M311 307 L317 319 L323 307" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="332" y="292" font-size="15" fill="#b45309">mg</text>
<text x="330" y="170" font-size="15" fill="#1d4ed8">T</text>
<g font-size="18" fill="#334155">
<text x="420" y="94">for B:  mg − T = ma</text>
<text x="420" y="130">for A:  T − F = Ma</text>
<text x="420" y="176" fill="#0f766e">whole system:</text>
<text x="420" y="208" fill="#0f766e">mg − F = (M + m)a</text></g>
<g font-size="16" fill="#64748b">
<text x="420" y="256">same string ⇒ same tension</text>
<text x="420" y="282">connected ⇒ same acceleration</text>
<text x="420" y="316" fill="#b45309">system equation hides T —</text>
<text x="420" y="340" fill="#b45309">use one particle to find it</text></g></svg>

name: 74-inclined-planes-p03-1.png

<path d="M-6 -88 L0 -100 L6 -88" fill="#0f766e"/>

<path d="M-108 -12 L-120 -6 L-108 0" fill="#4338ca"/></g>

name: 75-data-representation-p03-1.png
svg:

name: 76-measures-of-location-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A diagram comparing the mean, median and mode on a skewed distribution, with the mean pulled towards the tail, alongside the formulas for the mean of raw and grouped data" viewBox="0 0 760 370" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Three centres, three different jobs</text>
<line x1="60" y1="240" x2="420" y2="240" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M70 240 Q130 240 165 110 Q200 -10 250 160 Q300 236 410 238" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.55"/>
<line x1="178" y1="240" x2="178" y2="96" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2.6"/>
<text x="178" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#4338ca">mode</text>
<line x1="206" y1="240" x2="206" y2="130" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>
<text x="212" y="122" font-size="15" fill="#0f766e">median</text>
<line x1="240" y1="240" x2="240" y2="166" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-dasharray="3 4"/>
<text x="248" y="182" font-size="15" fill="#b45309">mean</text>

<text x="450" y="282" fill="#0f766e">of the ordered data</text>
<text x="450" y="322" fill="#b45309">mode: the most frequent value</text></g>
<text x="380" y="356" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#334155">the median resists outliers; the mean does not</text></svg>

name: 77-measures-of-spread-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A diagram showing two distributions with the same mean but different spreads, alongside the formulas for variance and standard deviation and the interquartile range" viewBox="0 0 760 370" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Same centre, different spread</text>
<line x1="60" y1="230" x2="420" y2="230" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M120 230 Q200 30 280 230" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.5"/>
<path d="M64 230 Q200 128 416 230" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="3" fill="#ecfdf5" fill-opacity="0.55"/>
<line x1="200" y1="230" x2="200" y2="52" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
<text x="200" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#4338ca">common mean</text>

<line x1="320" y1="112" x2="320" y2="188" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="3.6"/>
<line x1="460" y1="150" x2="560" y2="150" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.6"/>
<line x1="560" y1="130" x2="560" y2="170" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="3"/>

<text x="430" y="122" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#475569">1 certain</text>

name: 80-probability-rules-p03-1.png
svg:
<svg role="img" aria-label="A diagram showing the addition rule on a Venn diagram of overlapping events beside mutually exclusive events, together with the multiplication rule for independent events" viewBox="0 0 760 380" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px">
<text x="380" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#334155">Adding and multiplying probabilities</text>

<text x="122" y="140" font-size="17" fill="#1d4ed8">A</text>
<text x="262" y="140" font-size="17" fill="#0f766e">B</text>
<text x="193" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#4338ca">A∩B</text>
<text x="195" y="232" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">overlap counted twice — subtract it</text>
<rect x="420" y="60" width="290" height="150" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="505" cy="135" r="52" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.7" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.2"/>

<text x="625" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#0f766e">B</text>
<text x="565" y="232" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">mutually exclusive: no overlap</text>
<g font-size="19" fill="#4338ca">
<text x="380" y="286" text-anchor="middle">P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B)</text>

<text x="380" y="358" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0f766e">independent: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B)</text></g></svg>
